proposed_mapping.existing_objective: 从专题目录选择具体问题并记录不同文章的定义和先修条件
basis: The volume contents identifies two essays on foundations of number, with distinct internal topic lists.
First essay I explicitly presupposes rational arithmetic and uses R for rational numbers; IV defines an ordered two-class cut.
Second essay I paragraphs 1–3 defines thing/system/part, explicitly excludes empty systems in this exposition; II paragraph 21 defines transformation using those earlier objects.
A reader can choose a shared question about starting objects, definitions and assumptions, then record each essay separately without assuming a single modern convention.
proposed_mapping.classification_boundary: A mere bound volume would not suffice. Here contents, shared foundations-of-number theme and actual differing starting conventions support the stated reading objective. Its additional translated-volume identity does not certify translation accuracy or make it conference proceedings. This is an instructional example, not a formal reclassification of the historical volume.
